review: Package 3 Group 7 final artifact visual review
method: Direct visual inspection of both original PNGs in every listed pair using view_image, supported by read-only RGB pixel comparison. No screenshots were composited, edited or aligned for this review.
conclusion: No substantive visible migration mismatch was found in the 25 reviewed final pairs. All ten native lower joins visibly paint the outro, ticker, reassurance band and beginning of Books with matching spacing and proportions. Native hover and focus states are visibly present and match. Representative normal, header context and motion snapshots match. The inherited 320px targeted 200% progression clipping remains a quality finding. Coverage is established by the combined captures, not by a claim that every full-hero locator screenshot is completely painted. This review does not grant founder acceptance or publication approval.

findings.detail: All ten published/source native viewport pairs show the complete outro, ticker and reassurance band plus the beginning of Books. No leaked sticky-header descendants are visible. Reassurance remains immediately before Books.

Both native hover pairs show the actual active treatment. Both focus pairs show the expected teal carousel or gold ticker outline. Their report records also assert the required state before and after capture.
Your memories clips beyond the left viewport edge and A keepsake for life beyond the right in both pages. Matching this inherited defect is not a quality pass and no repair approval is inferred.

The final 320px oversized locator screenshots still end with an unpainted pale terminal strip where the lower hero/ticker coverage is incomplete. The separate native-scrolled join screenshots visibly establish the actual ticker and reassurance rendering. This is not accepted UI behaviour.

limits: Only the 50 filenames listed in pairs were visually reviewed in this final artifact. The rest of the 136 captures were not manually re-reviewed during this final audit.

The final representative normal coverage is 320px photograph 1, 820px photograph 2 and 1440px photograph 3. Earlier initial-artifact review of all ten widths and all three photos is separate evidence and is not counted as final-artifact inspection.

Oversized full-hero locator screenshots can include blank terminal compositor strips. Combined native lower-join and header-context coverage is required; this review does not claim a single fully painted full-page screenshot.
The reviewed header contexts have a fixed 900px viewport height. They establish header and top-hero relationship, not the reassurance join; those joins have separate native captures.
Short-screen states at 320x568, 820x500 and 1440x500 have measurements in the report but no dedicated screenshot files. No short-screen visual review is claimed.
Motion images are snapshots at recorded native animation phases, not a visual examination of continuous motion. Functional and timing assertions belong to report.json.
Chromium only. Touch was browser input emulation. Targeted text enlargement is not native browser zoom, a physical-device test, a screen-reader test or accessibility certification.
Founder rendered acceptance, complete homepage parity and approval to replace the published homepage remain separate gates.
